summary: The source contract fixes the complete candidate universe at the nine digits 1 through 9, so no legal family can scale that principal workload asymptotically.

workload_bound.source_constraint: Every combination draws without reuse from exactly the fixed values 1 through 9, with 2 <= k <= 9.

replacement_checks.evidence: Strictly increasing choices identify every recursive state with one subset of the nine digits, so at most 2^9 subset states can be visited. Each returned path has length k, making traversal plus output copying O(2^9 + Rk), which is within O(2^9 k). The recursion path contains at most k values.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition; scaling is replaced by the finite-domain proof rather than synthetic workload sizes.
